name: bPrivate
compatibility: OpenAI chat-completions-compatible for non-streaming JSON POST requests
invariants: mode off forwards request and response bytes without privacy transformation
mode on recursively maps configured values to stable opaque placeholders
session mapping persists for the gateway process and is never sent outbound
response content and tool-call arguments are recursively decoded locally
decode and validation fail closed on unknown placeholders, raw values, or mapping content
protected source/result/mapping paths represented in tool arguments are rejected
gateway never logs raw request or response content
staging is UTF-8 text-only and does not process binary or images
integration_boundary: This prototype performs local gateway forwarding only; later Hermes integration must call path policy, encode, outbound validation, and local decode in that order.
runtime: Python standard library; tests use unittest only
